question: Why explain the full sequence of rites if each can yield the supreme attainment?
premises: From mantra-repetition to offering, each individual rite can give rise to the supreme attainment.
This means no single rite is absolutely necessary as the only means.
Nevertheless, the sequence has been explained in this way for understanding and practice.
inference: Although each rite can independently lead to the supreme result, the tradition still sets out the full sequence as a clear exposition.
plain_english: Although, from mantra-repetition to offering, the supreme attainment can arise in each individual rite, the matter has nevertheless been explained in this way.
